author: (Lowe, 1843)

note.en: A soft-headed grenadier of the slope; it lives below 200 m and is only a regional record.
note.es: Un granadero de cabeza blanda de la pendiente; vive bajo los 200 m y es solo un registro regional.

evidence: FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the Western Central Atlantic, with no local sighting reports found
